overview: Minty is a premium mobile-first app with a vertical snap-scroll video feed on the Releases tab, showing 15-second HD clips with likes, filtering, and creator profiles. The app also includes an interactive Pet tab with an animated mascot and a Leaderboard tab.
features: Vertical snap-scroll video feed with autoplay and looping
Like system with duplicate prevention and live counts
Creator profile pages with clip grids
Safe View toggle for explicit content filtering
Interactive pet mascot (old Asian man with cane)
